note: YouTube Shorts cut from the Wolverine analysis long-form (render v3, public 2026-11-13 as https://youtu.be/ibU1j1niRQM). Bryce, 2026-11-13: 2 Shorts a day replace the paused lore Shorts. Each pick is one question and its answer from the script's own claims, cut on narration sentence boundaries. parts: a run of beats with an optional first phrase (from) and last phrase (to); several parts join with a hard cut. Ending-spoiler picks come after the first three and carry a SPOILERS tag. start, end, seconds, cuts, description and tags are written by tools/analysis_shorts.py; youtube is written by --upload.

game_lines._note: Game lines as heard in the v3 render and shown in the game's own subtitles (frames checked 2026-11-13). Several edl cues quote a different line than the render plays: b005 carries no clear line (the subtitle 'I'd like to help you, if I could.' clears at 108.1 s, so the line sits under the end of b004's narration; Whisper hears only a grunt), b040 stops before 'and that you are loved', b050 plays 'And so was she.' (clip 36 at 110-113 s), not 'It's a nice story.' (clip 36 at 116.8-120.3 s). b032 is labelled Essex in the game's subtitle (clip 26 at 17.5-21 s, hidden by the HUD crop); b035 opens with Logan's lines before Jean's warning; b045 ends with Jean asking 'A story?'.
game_lines.b012: I burnt every trace of Death out of your mind. Or so I thought.
game_lines.b032: Forget her. Look at me! You'd be nothing...
game_lines.b040: Why is this happening... Because I needed you to know that I remember. And that I forgive you.
game_lines.b045: Even if I wanted to remember, it just sounds like a... A story?
game_lines.b048: And for a while, the boy was happy.
game_lines.b035: Too strong... You have to... Like Callisto and... Please... They were just corrupted. Death is a part of you. If I burn it out... There will be nothing of you left.
